Title: Rosacea Triggers Doctors Want You to Know (It's Not Just Blushing)

Description:
Rosacea causes persistent redness and visible blood vessels on the cheeks, nose, and forehead - and it's often mistaken for acne or simply blushing easily. In patient surveys, sun exposure (81%), emotional stress (79%), and hot weather (75%) topped the list of triggers that make flare-ups worse.

Watch to find out why UV rays and stress hormones both dilate facial blood vessels, and the daily habits - from SPF 30+ to trigger tracking - that over 90% of patients say actually help.
